camel_example: aliyun vod AddVodTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --TemplateConfig '{"SnapshotConfig":{"Count":10,"SpecifiedOffsetTime":0,"Interval":1,"FrameType":"normal"},"SnapshotType":"NormalSnapshot"}' --TemplateType Snapshot --Name test
description_en: Creates a snapshot or animated image template
description_zh: 调用本接口添加截图或动图模板
kebab_example: aliyun vod add-vod-template --name test --template-type Snapshot --template-config '{"SnapshotConfig":{"Count":10,"SpecifiedOffsetTime":0,"Interval":1,"FrameType":"normal"},"SnapshotType":"NormalSnapshot"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddVodTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The name of the template.

The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.
The name must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
模板名称。

长度不超过128个字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype. Valid values:
Snapshot: snapshot.
DynamicImage: animated image
parameters.help_zh:
模板类型。取值：
Snapshot：截图。
DynamicImage：动图
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The configuration data of the template in JSON format. For more information about the data structure, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98618.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98618.html
parameters.help_zh: 模板配置数据（JSON格式）。数据结构详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98618.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98618.html
parameters.name: template_config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。默认取值app-1000000。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

VodTemplateId.description_en:
The ID of the snapshot or animated image template.
You can use this ID as a request parameter in the [SubmitSnapshotJob](~~SubmitSnapshotJob~~) or [SubmitDynamicImageJob](~~SubmitDynamicImageJob~~) operation to initiate snapshot or animated image processing
VodTemplateId.description_zh:
截图或动图模板ID。
可作为[SubmitSnapshotJob](~~SubmitSnapshotJob~~)或[SubmitDynamicImageJob](~~SubmitDynamicImageJob~~)接口的请求参数，发起截图或动图处理
